title: Unique Friend | RealAI CEO: Digital Employees Everyone Can Use

author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend Q&A · October 14, 2024 · Guest: CEO, RealAI / 实在智能

Note: Inventory type remains insight (Unique Friend series). Not retagged partner.

Product: Leader in intelligent office / RPA — digital employees for enterprises & government. Stack: RPA bots, Agent, TARS LLM, IDP, Enterprise Brain. 2,500+ top clients across finance, manufacturing, telco, e-commerce, tobacco, energy, transport.

  • RPA: rich component library; zero-code → low-threshold “point & pick” → LLM-era “say it, get it.” Domestic-chip / 信创 friendly.
  • IDP: OCR + NLP for contracts, expenses, vouchers.
  • Agent: claimed first productized commercial autonomous process agent — one sentence → steps → drive PC/phone/in-car UIs; calls RPA/IDP + 1,000+ common apps (IM, Office, e-commerce, travel, finance, sales).
  • Enterprise Brain: LLM + Agent + RAG ops platform for conversational process, Q&A, analytics, content gen.

GenAI impact: Advances digital employees from junior→senior (unstructured data, decisions, context). Agent UX expands users ~10%→90% and scenes ~30%→90%. Pricing: ToB→also ToC daily assistants; lower deploy cost/time stretches the same budget across more automations.

Ecosystem: 800+ channel/partners — Huawei, Dahua, DingTalk, Hundsun, DBAPPSecurity, iFlytek, Lianhui, Yanzhi, Zhenli, etc. Open compute + model ecosystem.

Challenges: Compute limits; solution upgrades; agent adoption. Claims global-front-rank process-agent landing.

2024 trends: LLM×automation; IDP CAGR ~30.1% (2023–30) in doc-heavy industries; GenAI/LLM impact over 3–5 years; AI safety/governance; AI agents in CS/coding/analytics; no-/low-code for non-engineers.

— END —
